notes: Seed payload for a clean launch catalog with EU shooting-focused listings only. Replaces previous environment content with curated shoot-first operators and clubs.

documents.name: Riflesafe Academy
documents.shortDescription: Precision rifle and pistol coaching with instructor-led safety and licence pathways. Sessions cover drills, match prep, and confidence building for active members.
documents.longDescription: Riflesafe Academy in Budapest delivers structured live-fire instruction across rifle and pistol disciplines, with certified instructors and dedicated safety oversight for every session. Members can choose structured beginner blocks, licensing support tracks, and competition preparation sessions that include scenario drills, score analysis, and practical range routines. The team also offers weekend open coaching and recurring match-focused clinics in collaboration with nearby regional clubs.
documents.announcementDescription: Saturday and Sunday 10:00 sessions include competition drills and scoring support.

documents.name: Scholz Precision Range
documents.shortDescription: Indoor and long-range rifle facility with coaching lanes, lanes for dynamic drills, and event-day support in one booking flow.
documents.longDescription: Scholz Precision Range is an all-weather facility in Bavaria built for serious practice, with dedicated benchrest and dynamic lanes, coached station support, and structured lane reservation handling for groups. The venue hosts recurring domestic match weekends and is a practical option for operators, visitors, and hunters needing reliable practice windows around travel windows.
documents.announcementDescription: Saturday access includes coaching support and lane availability for 20 participants.

documents.name: Barcelona Clay Derby League
documents.shortDescription: Monthly clay and practical match events with certified range staff, score tracking, and safe lane discipline.
documents.longDescription: Barcelona Clay Derby League organizes recurring clay and practical competition sessions focused on safe participation, consistent scoring, and progression-friendly rule checks. Teams can book match tracks, review venue details in advance, and confirm lane schedules around regional travel windows.
documents.announcementDescription: Open entries and timed tracks available for visiting teams and local crews.

documents.name: Po Valley Field Fieldstation
documents.shortDescription: Guided hunting-field familiarization and shot-placement clinics for licensed participants and guided access coordination.
documents.longDescription: Po Valley Fieldstation coordinates short, supervised hunting-ground field days for experienced members who need practical orientation before bigger campaigns. Programs include safety briefing, movement coaching, and field marking practice with local guide support where seasonal access is permitted.
documents.announcementDescription: Field practice and access orientation run on weekends during open seasons.

documents.name: Paris Arc & Target Club
documents.shortDescription: Technical club format with structured coaching, target scoring, and venue-specific qualification pathways.
documents.longDescription: Paris Arc & Target Club runs repeatable weekday and evening sessions built around repeatable scoring sessions, shooter discipline progression, and practical event preparation. The coaching team focuses on precision and consistency, suitable for members who train frequently and want an operator-ready cadence.
documents.announcementDescription: Dedicated target prep and qualification support available after 17:00.

documents.name: Budapest IDSC Squad
documents.description: Regional competitive shooting crews coordinating monthly match rehearsals, equipment checks, and travel-ready group training for adult participants.

documents.name: European Field & Hunter Circle
documents.description: Community for hunting and field-range access, route planning, and practical compliance updates for active EU operators.
